item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json,pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('/workspace/mcp-eval')
observed=[]
for label in ['evaluation','repeat']:
 status=json.loads((p/(label+'-status.json')).read_text())['body']
 iterations=json.loads((p/(label+'-iterations.json')).read_text())['body']['items']
 assert status['status']=='completed' and status['result']=='passed'
 assert len(iterations)==1 and iterations[0]['result']=='passed'
 calls=iterations[0]['actualToolCalls']
 assert len(calls)==1
 c=calls[0]
 assert c['toolName']=='add' and c['arguments']=={'a':2,'b':3}
 assert c['result']['structuredContent']['sum']==5 and c['result']['isError'] is False
 observed.append(calls)
assert observed[0]==observed[1]
(p/'verification.json').write_text(json.dumps({'runs':['run_fixture_1','run_fixture_2'],'passedCases':2,'totalCases':2,'matchingToolEvidence':True,'scope':'simulated arithmetic smoke; no hosted model or live billing'},indent=2))
print('Verified both completed runs passed and have identical add(2,3) -> 5 evidence.')
PY"
